$$
\begin{aligned}&\begin{bmatrix}2 & 0 & 1 \\ 3 & -1 & 4 \\ 0 & 2 & 5\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 1 \\ 3 & 0 & 2 \\ 2 & 1 & 3\end{bmatrix} \\ & =\begin{bmatrix}2+0+2 & 4+0+1 & 2+0+3 \\ 3-3+8 & 6+0+4 & 3-2+12 \\ 0+6+10 & 0+0+5 & 0+4+15\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}4 & 5 & 5 \\ 8 & 10 & 13 \\ 16 & 5 & 19\end{bmatrix}.\end{aligned}

$$
\begin{aligned}&\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & -3 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & 5\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}-1 & -1 & -4 \\ -5 & 1 & 0 \\ -3 & -1 & 2\end{bmatrix} \\ & =\begin{bmatrix}-1-10-3 & -1+2-1 & -4+0+2 \\ -1+15+0 & -1-3+0 & -4+0+0 \\ 0+15-15 & 0-3-5 & 0+0+10\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}-14 & 0 & -2 \\ 14 & -4 & -4 \\ 0 & -8 & 10\end{bmatrix}.\end{aligned}
$$

Multiplying each row in the first matrix by each column in the second, we get

 

$$
\begin{aligned}BC & =\begin{bmatrix}1 & 3 & 6 \\ -1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -2\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}1 & -4 & -5 \\ -2 & 1 & 4 \\ 1 & 0 & -3\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}1-6+6 & -4+3+0 & -5+12-18 \\ -1+0+2 & 4+0+0 & 5+0-6 \\ 0-2-2 & 0+1+0 & 0+4+6\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}1 & -1 & -11 \\ 1 & 4 & -1 \\ -4 & 1 & 10\end{bmatrix}.\end{aligned}

question.:question/problem:
Calculate $AB$, where $$ A=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & -1\end{bmatrix} $$ and $$ B=\begin{bmatrix}2 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & -1 & 2 \\ 0 & 2 & 1\end{bmatrix} $$ Use a row of $A$ and a column of $B$ for each missing entry. For example, the entry in row 1, column 2 is $1\cdot1+0\cdot(-1)+2\cdot2$. Complete the product.
$AB=$
$2${{field-1}}$2$
$2$$-2${{field-2}}
{{field-3}}$-1$$-1$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Multiply each row of $A$ by each column of $B$, adding the three pairwise products. The supplied entries and the missing entries all follow this rule.

$$
\begin{aligned}c_{11} &= 1\cdot2+0\cdot1+2\cdot0 = 2 \\ c_{12} &= 1\cdot1+0\cdot(-1)+2\cdot2 = 5 \\ c_{13} &= 1\cdot0+0\cdot2+2\cdot1 = 2\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}c_{21} &= 0\cdot2+2\cdot1+0\cdot0 = 2 \\ c_{22} &= 0\cdot1+2\cdot(-1)+0\cdot2 = -2 \\ c_{23} &= 0\cdot0+2\cdot2+0\cdot1 = 4\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}c_{31} &= 1\cdot2+0\cdot1+(-1)\cdot0 = 2 \\ c_{32} &= 1\cdot1+0\cdot(-1)+(-1)\cdot2 = -1 \\ c_{33} &= 1\cdot0+0\cdot2+(-1)\cdot1 = -1\end{aligned}
$$
Therefore,
$$
AB=\begin{bmatrix}2 & 5 & 2 \\ 2 & -2 & 4 \\ 2 & -1 & -1\end{bmatrix}.
$$

question.:question/problem:
Calculate $AB$, where $$ A=\begin{bmatrix}2 & -1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 2 & 1\end{bmatrix} $$ and $$ B=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -1 \\ -2 & 1 & 2 \\ 3 & -1 & 1\end{bmatrix} $$ Complete the product.
$AB=$
{{field-1}}$2${{field-2}}
$-5${{field-3}}$-3$
{{field-4}}$1${{field-5}}
question.:question/worked-solution:
Multiply each row of $A$ by each column of $B$, adding the three pairwise products. The supplied entries and the missing entries all follow this rule.

$$
\begin{aligned}c_{11} &= 2\cdot1+(-1)\cdot(-2)+1\cdot3 = 7 \\ c_{12} &= 2\cdot2+(-1)\cdot1+1\cdot(-1) = 2 \\ c_{13} &= 2\cdot(-1)+(-1)\cdot2+1\cdot1 = -3\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}c_{21} &= 1\cdot1+0\cdot(-2)+(-2)\cdot3 = -5 \\ c_{22} &= 1\cdot2+0\cdot1+(-2)\cdot(-1) = 4 \\ c_{23} &= 1\cdot(-1)+0\cdot2+(-2)\cdot1 = -3\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}c_{31} &= 0\cdot1+2\cdot(-2)+1\cdot3 = -1 \\ c_{32} &= 0\cdot2+2\cdot1+1\cdot(-1) = 1 \\ c_{33} &= 0\cdot(-1)+2\cdot2+1\cdot1 = 5\end{aligned}
$$
Therefore,
$$
AB=\begin{bmatrix}7 & 2 & -3 \\ -5 & 4 & -3 \\ -1 & 1 & 5\end{bmatrix}.
$$

question.:question/problem:
Calculate $AB$, where $$ A=\begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 & 3 \\ -1 & 2 & 1 \\ 2 & 1 & -2\end{bmatrix} $$ and $$ B=\begin{bmatrix}2 & -1 & 1 \\ 1 & 3 & -2 \\ -1 & 2 & 3\end{bmatrix} $$ Complete the product.
$AB=$
{{field-1}}{{field-2}}{{field-3}}
{{field-4}}{{field-5}}{{field-6}}
{{field-7}}{{field-8}}{{field-9}}
question.:question/worked-solution:
Multiply each row of $A$ by each column of $B$, adding the three pairwise products. Compute all nine entries in row order.

$$
\begin{aligned}c_{11} &= 1\cdot2+(-2)\cdot1+3\cdot(-1) = -3 \\ c_{12} &= 1\cdot(-1)+(-2)\cdot3+3\cdot2 = -1 \\ c_{13} &= 1\cdot1+(-2)\cdot(-2)+3\cdot3 = 14\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}c_{21} &= (-1)\cdot2+2\cdot1+1\cdot(-1) = -1 \\ c_{22} &= (-1)\cdot(-1)+2\cdot3+1\cdot2 = 9 \\ c_{23} &= (-1)\cdot1+2\cdot(-2)+1\cdot3 = -2\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}c_{31} &= 2\cdot2+1\cdot1+(-2)\cdot(-1) = 7 \\ c_{32} &= 2\cdot(-1)+1\cdot3+(-2)\cdot2 = -3 \\ c_{33} &= 2\cdot1+1\cdot(-2)+(-2)\cdot3 = -6\end{aligned}
$$
Therefore,
$$
AB=\begin{bmatrix}-3 & -1 & 14 \\ -1 & 9 & -2 \\ 7 & -3 & -6\end{bmatrix}.
$$
